Also electric tent, primitive tent and group sites.

summary: Confirmed $45/night RV base (fees left as recorded, still 'Prices start at $45 per night (+taxes and fees)' on every RV site) and 50-amp electric. Added water at every RV site, septic at two sites, max rig 28 ft (only sites 1, 8, 9 and 4 fit 23 ft), showers/dump/camp store/wifi at the store, season mid-April (2027) to Oct 31, online booking on the operator's site.
